# Track 2: Domain Science Bachelor Track

This track is intended for students who enter the RSE Master with a **Bachelor in a domain
subject** — natural sciences and technology (MNT), social sciences (SoWi), the humanities (HuWi),
and related fields. These students first acquire the computer-science and software-engineering
foundations they are missing, then deepen the computational methods of their own domain alongside
the RSE-specific competencies.

The curriculum follows the six competency areas (*Bereiche*) of Table 5.1 of the curricular
recommendations. The table below reproduces that structure with the ECTS that apply to Track 2.

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}

## Curriculum Structure (Track 2)

| Area / Module | ECTS |
|---|---:|
| **Computer Science** | **18** |
| [Foundations of Computer Science](../modules/gen_cs.qmd) | 6 * |
| [Foundations of Software Development](../modules/gen_softwareeng1.qmd) | 6 * |
| [Algorithms and Data Structures](../modules/gen_programming.qmd) | 6 * |
| Computer Science Elective | 0 |
| **Software Engineering** | **0** |
| [Requirements Engineering](../modules/standard.qmd) | 0 * |
| [Software Architecture](../modules/standard.qmd) | 0 * |
| [Software Testing](../modules/standard.qmd) | 0 * |
| **Domain Specializations** | **27** |
| [Domain Specialization Electives (own domain)](../modules/mnt_wildcard.qmd) | 21 |
| [Computational Research in the Domain](../modules/mnt_compwildcard.qmd) | 6 |
| **Technical Competencies for RSEs** | **21** |
| [Applied Software Development Tools and Techniques](../modules/rse_nuts_bolts.qmd) | 3 |
| [Introduction to Scientific Computing](../modules/rse_scientificcomputing.qmd) | 6 |
| [Machine Learning](../modules/standard.qmd) | 6 |
| [Software Development for RSEs](../modules/rse_softwareengineering.qmd) | 6 |
| **Social Competencies for RSEs** | **12** |
| [RSEng Management](../modules/rse_management.qmd) | 6 |
| [RSEng, Ethics & Society](../modules/rse_society_philosophy.qmd) | 3 |
| [RSEng Teaching](../modules/rse_teaching.qmd) | 3 |
| **RSEng Research** | **42** |
| [RSEng Lecture Series](../modules/rse_lectureseries.qmd) | 3 |
| [Research Paradigms and Methodology for RSEs](../modules/rse_researchmethods.qmd) | 3 |
| [RSEng Project](../modules/mnt_project.qmd) | 6 |
| [Master's Thesis](../modules/rse_thesis.qmd) | 30 |
| **Total** | **120** |

: Modules and ECTS for Track 2 {tbl-colwidths="[80,20]"}

**\*** If students already acquired programming skills in their domain Bachelor, they may replace
the Computer Science foundations (up to 18 ECTS) with elective Software Engineering courses
(Requirements Engineering, Software Architecture, Software Testing; up to 12 ECTS) or other
advanced courses. Universities may also make some of these courses mandatory prerequisites
(*Auflagen*). The Computer Science / Software Engineering block sums to 18 ECTS in total for this
track.
